turns.customer: First time boarding Coco. What should I bring? Can she eat her own food?
blocks:
Yes—Coco can have her usual food. Happy Tails encourages bringing the food she eats at home; if you forget, their site says in-house food can be provided at the owner’s request for **$3 per day**. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding))

For her stay, consider bringing:
- **Her regular food** and clear feeding instructions.
- **A toy only if you like**: the resort provides bedding, and allows one hard chew toy at least 2½ inches wide. No rawhides, rope toys, or destructible toys. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding))
- **Written vaccination and screening records from your vet**—the resort requires these before boarding. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding))

The site also says medications can be administered, but doesn’t specify what to pack or how to label them, so confirm those details with the resort before drop-off. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/services/dog-boarding))
